Gold.note: Positive momentum and safe-haven demand amid expected rate cuts.

Silver.note: Stronger momentum than gold with added industrial demand from solar.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and robust electrification demand driving structural deficit.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear build-out.

Lithium.note: Continued market oversupply and delayed EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply outpacing sluggish battery demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate supply and smelter treatment charge squeezes.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector offsets resilient infrastructure steel demand.

Coal.note: Normalizing inventories and peak energy demand passing.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply constraints from China offsetting steady EV demand.

Manganese.note: Logistics bottlenecks in South Africa balance steady steelmaking demand.

PGM.note: Recovering auto production and structural supply deficits in platinum.

Potash.note: Normalizing global supply chains easing previous fertilizer shortages.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and rising green energy demand.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and iron ore offsets macro headwinds.
